title: Extremal F-thresholds in regular local rings
summary: Let $(R, \mathfrak{m})$ be a regular local ring of characteristic $p > 0$. Among all proper ideals $\mathfrak{a}\subseteq R$ with a fixed order of vanishing $\text{ord}_{\mathfrak{m}}(\mathfrak{a})$, we classify the ideals for which the $F$-threshold $\text{ft}^{\mathfrak{m}}(\mathfrak{a})$ is minimal.
